observations: White dry iron on a tiled floor.
Power cord shows significant fraying and exposed inner wiring near the plug.
Cord entry point to the iron body appears damaged or frayed.
No brand name or model number is visible on the top or sides of the casing.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the iron unplugged with a damaged cord; functionality cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: Electrical shock or fire hazard due to frayed power cord
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the cord or a video showing it has been replaced

risks.risk: Soleplate may be burnt, rusted, or heavily scratched

risks.proof: Video of the iron indicator light turning on and steam/heat being produced

proof_requests: Photo of the soleplate (the bottom of the iron)
Photo of the manufacturer's label/plate for brand and wattage
Video showing the iron plugged in and the indicator light working
response.reason: The item is a generic dry iron. Due to the visible and severe damage to the power cord, it must be priced at its worst case as a non-functional or hazardous unit requiring repair.
